purpose: Teach: 微分/散らし/弁明/欺瞞/排泄/捕鯨/抗争/殺戮

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯罪統計の微分分析を警察、なさってますね
lines.en: The police are conducting differential analysis on crime statistics for this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost academic tone. Measured pace. Slight upward lilt on the question, genuinely curious rather than challenging. Respectful distance maintained.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場に散らした証拠物を慎重に回収します
lines.en: We collect evidence from crime scenes with careful precision and attention to detail.
lines.style: Official but not cold. Steady, professional cadence. Each phrase lands with quiet assurance. Matter-of-fact authority without lecturing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の弁明を警察、検証されてますね
lines.en: The police are verifying the suspect's statements in this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Inquisitive, slightly formal. Gentle probing rather than accusatory. Pause before the question tag, as if considering the implications. Tone suggests he's thinking through it alongside the listener.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、組織内の欺瞞行為を厳しく追及します
lines.en: We pursue internal deception within organizations with rigorous scrutiny.
lines.style: Firm and deliberate. Underlying resolve in the word 'deception.' Measured delivery that conveys seriousness without aggression. Professional boundary clearly maintained.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不法排泄事案を警察、摘発されてますね
lines.en: The police are cracking down on illegal dumping cases like this one, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful and observant. Gentle questioning tone. Slight pause mid-phrase, as if Ren is piecing together details. Sincere interest in how the investigation unfolds.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不法捕鯨に関する情報も収集します
lines.en: We also gather information regarding illegal whaling activities.
lines.style: Calm and factual. Slight emphasis on 'also' to show comprehensiveness. Steady rhythm, conveying procedural diligence without drama. Professional clarity throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、組織間の抗争を警察、抑止されてますね
lines.en: The police are preventing inter-organizational conflicts in this situation, aren't they?
lines.style: Observant and measured. Slight intellectual distance, as if Ren is noting something important. Genuine question, not rhetorical. Calm, steady pacing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、無差別殺戮事件に厳重対応します
lines.en: We respond to indiscriminate violent crimes with maximum vigilance and force.
lines.style: Grave and resolute. Deliberate pace, each word weighted. Serious shift in tone from previous lines—this is life-and-death. No room for uncertainty. Eye-level intensity.
